description: This file defines the DefaultClusterRolesConfig class, which implements the HealthCheckConfig.ClusterRolesConfig interface. It manages configuration related to cluster roles in a gateway health check system, including enabled status and expected roles, and provides methods for creating instances from Config objects.

classes.name: DefaultClusterRolesConfig
classes.description: Immutable class representing the cluster roles configuration for the health check system.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultClusterRolesConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the cluster roles configuration is enabled.

methods.name: getExpectedClusterRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of expected cluster roles.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare DefaultClusterRolesConfig instances.

methods.description: Provides a string representation of the DefaultClusterRolesConfig instance.
